speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Parliament. York may bring word. Nobody is to see a crown change hands.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: "A brittle glory shineth in this face. As brittle as the glory is the face."

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the speech he cut. Give me the glass, Dick. It can lie in the coffer with the rest.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: No. The Master has the book. I have the glass. Let him come up to Shoreditch and take it out of my hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it, then. Only do not break it in a play he has not licensed.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I'll not break it. I'll look in it.
